relevance_note: National survey describing 54 HA20 patients one by one in supplementary tables: "All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3".
method_note: Read the whole Markdown, including the supplementary material. A Python script (scratch dir) built the rows from my readings. It sliced spans from the table lines of Supplementary Table 1 (sex, onset, genotype, treatment, reference) and Supplementary Table 2 (features) and asserted each expected cell text; I checked the output against both tables. Labels use the 'P<n>' form used in all supplementary tables; the text also writes 'patient <n>'. Family labels 'F<n>' come from Supplementary Table 1; the relatives' families are inferred from the related patient. cDNA and protein strings come from the family headers of Supplementary Figure 1 (pedigree PDF text, columns aligned by family; each was checked against the Supplementary Table 1 genotype). For large deletions the Supplementary Table 1 cell is used. No transcript is printed. Variant class is given only where the authors name it: missense for p.E192K/p.C243Y, splice-site for the minigene variants, deletion for the large deletions. Frameshift/nonsense classes are not stated per variant. Ethnicity: 'Japanese' for every patient except P51, from 'Fifty-three ... Japanese and one was Vietnamese (patient 51)'. Supplementary Table 2 '−'/'-' cells are not defined in any legend, so they are treated as not reported (no excluded rows from them); '+' is read as present. 'HD' is mapped to Hashimoto's disease although the legend prints 'HS, Hashimoto’s disease' (8 HD entries match Table 2's 'Hashimoto’s disease (8)'). 'Intestinal symptoms +' is recorded as a feature but not as checklist 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation'. That item is observed only where an initial diagnosis names IBD, Crohn's disease or intestinal BD, or for P3 'gastrointestinal lesions' (the HCT sentence 'in our patient' is tied to P3, the only HCT patient). 'Recurrent stomatitis' is treated as oral ulcers for unnamed person 2, because the paper's Table 2 'Recurrent stomatitis 42' equals the 42 oral-ulcer '+' cells. Initial diagnoses that are not GI were not recorded as features. Supplementary Table 3 (anti-drug antibodies) and HLA data were not recorded. Out-of-scope or group-level only, so no rows: the 20 excluded missense cases (Supplementary Table 6 lists variants not tied to persons); the three asymptomatic heterozygous carriers and the 'non-analyzed genetically predisposed' relatives (pedigree symbols only); the two symptomatic family members of the p.Q760X case (count only); 72 total estimated patients; the ref (8) intracranial lesion report and the HCT/thalidomide literature counts. Included as in scope: mother of P3 and father of P18 (somatic mosaicism in blood, variant not printed); father of P38 (HA20, lymphoma at 35) and grandmother of P15 (suspected HA20, lymphoma at 70; ages from '(21, 35, and 70 years, respectively)'); two excluded mosaic cases (c.806-1G>T 22%, p.Q760X 14%) as unnamed persons 1-2; 'ref (16) patient' (death from progressive liver disease with cirrhosis). Main-text reference numbers such as (3), (16) and (20) cannot be resolved: the main reference list is absent from the file, and they are not the Supplementary reference numbers. Variant values drop Markdown escapes (c.806-1G>T; spans keep 'c.806-1G\>T'). Contradictions in the paper: (1) patient 49 is 'c.2099 + 1G>A' in the text but c.2088+1G>A in Supplementary Table 1 and Supplementary Figure 1; (2) c.986+1G>C (Supplementary Table 1 and Figure 1) is written c.986+1G>T in the minigene methods list; (3) the c.805+1G>A protein is p.Asn212GlufsX in Supplementary Figure 1 but p.Asp212GlufsX in the minigene results; (4) F13 is printed 'c.1434C<A' (kept verbatim); (5) Supplementary Table 2 has 20 genital-ulcer '+' cells but Table 2 says 19; (6) the supplement says the two mosaic individuals were asymptomatic, yet the p.Q760X individual 'had Behcet’s disease-like symptoms'. Which individuals the 'Two individuals ... asymptomatic' sentence refers to is ambiguous, so it was not used.
